title: Subconscious souls hanging out
content: Have you ever had a “knowing” after a dream that you just hung out with your friend/partner in a dream? I usually dream about my bf but the other night, I just knew it was him. Like my subconscious soul hanging out with my subconscious soul. We were in a huge log cabin mansion that had tall ceilings pointing up. Asked if he remembered and he said no, sadly. But cool experience that only occurs every so often.
